scope.population: 2,480,267 rows of the book-mid panel reduced to per-wallet means; a wallet enters a cell at that cell's fill floor, and the cells run over [50, 100] fills
scope.window: 10 days present in the input, day-of-month 4-13; this file makes no early-and-late split, so every day present enters every cell, and the calendar dates are declared by the panel's producer through i4_midmarkout.py

declared_not_confirmed.note: settings.py declares these; this run did not state what it used, so they are the declaration and not a property of this artifact

settings_fingerprint.overrides_note: n_perm is the declared budget, read from settings.py and no longer typed here; a p at the floor is still a bound and not a measurement, which is what placebo_residual_p_is_floor records; rank_floor_fills (50, 100) not the declared single 50, the second rung being the small-sample check; no bootstrap is drawn, so n_boot does not apply; no whale-drop arm runs here, so no drop criterion applies; the seed is settings.MASTER_SEED unchanged

object: I3-DEPTH - per-counterparty markout dispersion vs entry-book-state controls. SUPPORTED CLAIM (narrow): entry book state does NOT LINEARLY account for the between-wallet markout dispersion (book R^2 < 1%); identity dispersion survives LINEAR book-state residualization and beats a label-permutation null.

caveats.linear_retain_is_tautological: Linear book R^2 < 1%, so share_retained_fraction (~0.78-0.91) is largely a TAUTOLOGY of the near-zero R^2 (residualizing on ~0 explained variance can barely move the markout). Do not read it as strong structural evidence that identity is not a book-state proxy.
caveats.between_share_is_in_sample: between_share_* and share_retained_* are computed IN-SAMPLE (per-wallet means reused in numerator and denominator) and carry a ~1/K upward noise floor (between_share_in_sample_noise_floor); descriptive, not a clean effect size.
caveats.load_bearing_evidence: Significance rests on the label-permutation null (placebo_residual_p clears the floor) and the OUT-OF-SAMPLE leave-one-out per-taker R^2 (loo_taker_r2_residual ~ 0.03-0.08), NOT the retain ratio.
caveats.nonlinear_control_added: A NON-LINEAR book-state control (per-control deciles + pairwise interactions, R^2 of 1.9 to 3.4 times the linear fit) is added; the residual share still retains 0.80 to 0.89 of the raw share on it (share_retained_nonlinear) - that retain IS non-tautological.

scope.p_floor_note: 2000 draws cannot express a p below 0.000500; each cell carries placebo_residual_p_is_floor saying which of the two its p is
scope.question: Does entry book state (imb_entry, spread_entry_bps, micro_dev_bps) LINEARLY account for the per-counterparty (between-wallet) markout dispersion, and does that dispersion survive linear book-state residualization beyond a label-permutation null? (Answered: book state explains < 1% linearly; the dispersion survives and beats the null.) The earlier strong 'identity is not a book-state proxy' framing is retracted - see caveats.linear_retain_is_tautological.
scope.verdict_rule: identity_survives_linear_book_control = residual between-wallet share > 0 AND beats its label-permutation null (p<=0.05) AND the NON-LINEAR retain (share_retained_nonlinear, the non-tautological one) holds >= 50% of the raw share. This asserts only survival of the LINEAR book control + the label null - NOT strong structural exclusion.

ols_book_state.note: R^2 of entry book-state controls (LINEAR) on the raw markout. This fit explains < 1% of markout variance, so a high share_retained on the linear residual is largely a TAUTOLOGY of the near-zero R^2 (residualizing on ~0 explained variance can barely move the markout) and is NOT strong structural evidence. The supported claim is narrow: entry book state does not LINEARLY account for the between-wallet markout dispersion.

ols_book_state_nonlinear.note: R^2 of a NON-LINEAR book-state control (per-control deciles + pairwise interactions) on the raw markout. Larger than the linear R^2, so the retain on this residual (share_retained_nonlinear) is a non-tautological statement that identity dispersion survives a real book-state control.

placebo_procedure.method: permutation p = (draws at least as extreme + 1) / (usable draws + 1); the observed labelling counts as one draw of its own null, so p is floored at 1/(usable + 1) and is never zero

cells.disclosure: between_share_* and share_retained_* are IN-SAMPLE with a ~1/K noise floor (between_share_in_sample_noise_floor); the linear retain is largely a tautology of the < 1% book R^2. Load-bearing evidence = the label-permutation null (placebo_residual_p) and the OUT-OF-SAMPLE leave-one-out per-taker R^2 (loo_taker_r2_residual), NOT the retain ratio. share_retained_nonlinear is the non-tautological retain.
